podcast.body: Andy Gibb recorded his debut album in the same Miami studio where The Eagles were recording "Hotel California." He specifically aimed for "Flowing Rivers" to emulate the sound of "Hotel California," and some Eagles influence can be heard in the song "In the End," though his hit singles ultimately bore a strong resemblance to Bee Gees albums. "Andy said he wanted his flowing rivers album to sound like Hotel California."
